chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: "Mr. Paganini" and novelty numbers for Ella
summary: A novelty by a husband-and-wife team shows how Ella could handle any style, with songs sprung on her only when ready.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: It was kind of a corny thing. See, we picked -- See, Ella could do all types of things. So we would pick -- We would okay different (inaudible) things the fellow like that Mr. Paganini. I remember (inaudible) and her husband wrote that together. And they come up to the Savoy and when -- they were rehearsing it. When they was going over the piano, Chick say, "How you like that?" So I didn't say nothing. Chick say, "You don't like that?" "Yeah, I think it's a novelty. A good novelty thing, let's do it, you know." Ella liked it and she did a good job on it. It was a novelty type thing. A lot of things that we used to pull for Ella, she didn't know until we were ready. "Ella, come over, we got a couple of new songs."
